# LINE
> More than just a messenger app, LINE is a communication platform and everyday digital infrastructure spanning messaging, services, creators, business tools, and developer APIs.

LINE provides consumer apps, official accounts, creator ecosystems, and a broad developer platform including messaging APIs, login, mini apps, blockchain-related services, and enterprise integrations.

## Main Site
- [LINE Home](https://line.me/en/): English homepage for LINE’s messaging app, services, and platform overview.
- [Download LINE](https://line.me/en/download): Download LINE for iPhone, Android, desktop, and other supported platforms.
- [About LINE](https://line.me/en/): Overview of LINE’s core communication and lifestyle services.
- [Family Apps](https://line.me/en/): Entry point to LINE’s broader ecosystem of apps and connected services.

## Consumer Services
- [Messenger App](https://line.me/en/): Overview of LINE’s messaging, calls, stickers, and social communication features.
- [Stickers](https://store.line.me/home/en): Browse and purchase LINE stickers, emoji, and themes.
- [Themes](https://store.line.me/themeshop/home/en): Explore themes for customizing the LINE app experience.
- [LINE GAME](https://game.line.me/en/): Portal for LINE-connected mobile games and related content.
- [LINE VOOM](https://linevoom.line.me/): Short-form content and social feed experience within the LINE ecosystem.

## LINE Store and Creator Ecosystem
- [LINE STORE](https://store.line.me/home/en): Official web store for stickers, emoji, themes, and related digital items.
- [Creators Market](https://creator.line.me/en/): Create, publish, and manage stickers, emoji, and themes for LINE users.
- [Creators Market Guide](https://creator.line.me/en/guideline/): Submission rules and content guidelines for LINE creators.
- [LINE OpenChat](https://openchat.line.me/): Community chat spaces for shared interests and group conversations.
- [LINE NFT](https://nft.line.me/): Marketplace and platform for NFT-related experiences in the LINE ecosystem.

## Official Accounts and Business
- [LINE Official Account](https://www.linebiz.com/jp-en/service/line-official-account/): Business messaging accounts for customer communication and engagement.
- [LINE for Business](https://www.linebiz.com/jp-en/): Overview of business products, advertising, and account solutions.
- [LINE Ads](https://www.linebiz.com/jp-en/service/line-ads/): Advertising platform for reaching LINE users across services.
- [LINE Promotion Stickers](https://www.linebiz.com/jp-en/service/line-promotion-stickers/): Branded sticker campaigns for marketing and user acquisition.
- [Business Solutions](https://www.linebiz.com/jp-en/service/): Directory of LINE business and marketing services.

## Developers
- [LINE Developers](https://developers.line.biz/en/): Central hub for LINE APIs, SDKs, guides, and developer tools.
- [Documentation Home](https://developers.line.biz/en/docs/): Main documentation index for all LINE developer products.
- [API Reference](https://developers.line.biz/en/reference/): Reference documentation for LINE platform APIs.
- [LINE Developers Console](https://developers.line.biz/console/): Manage providers, channels, credentials, and app integrations.
- [News](https://developers.line.biz/en/news/): Product updates, releases, and announcements for developers.

## Messaging API and Platform APIs
- [Messaging API Overview](https://developers.line.biz/en/docs/messaging-api/overview/): Introduction to bots, webhooks, replies, push messages, and rich messaging.
- [Messaging API Reference](https://developers.line.biz/en/reference/messaging-api/): Endpoint reference for sending messages and managing messaging features.
- [Webhook Guide](https://developers.line.biz/en/docs/messaging-api/building-bot/): Guide to receiving events and building bot workflows with webhooks.
- [Flex Message](https://developers.line.biz/en/docs/messaging-api/using-flex-messages/): Build structured, customizable message layouts for rich chat experiences.
- [Rich Menu](https://developers.line.biz/en/docs/messaging-api/using-rich-menus/): Configure persistent chat menus for navigation and user actions.
- [LIFF Overview](https://developers.line.biz/en/docs/liff/overview/): Build web apps that run inside the LINE app.
- [LINE Login Overview](https://developers.line.biz/en/docs/line-login/overview/): Authenticate users with their LINE accounts in web and mobile apps.

## SDKs and Tools
- [LINE Bot SDKs](https://developers.line.biz/en/docs/messaging-api/line-bot-sdk/): Official SDK resources for building bots in supported languages.
- [LINE Front-end Framework (LIFF)](https://developers.line.biz/en/docs/liff/): Documentation for LINE’s in-app web application framework.
- [LINE Login SDKs](https://developers.line.biz/en/docs/line-login/integrate-line-login/): Integration guidance for implementing LINE Login in applications.
- [Sample Bots and Examples](https://github.com/line): Official GitHub organization with SDKs, samples, and developer tools.
- [LINE MINI App](https://developers.line.biz/en/docs/line-mini-app/overview/): Build mini apps integrated with LINE user experiences and services.

## Advanced Platform Services
- [LINE Blockchain Developers](https://docs-blockchain.line.biz/): Documentation for LINE’s blockchain-related developer platform and services.
- [LINE NEXT](https://www.linenextcorp.com/): Company and ecosystem information related to LINE’s Web3 initiatives.
- [LINE MINI App Docs](https://developers.line.biz/en/docs/line-mini-app/): Guides and references for mini app development on LINE.
- [LINE Things](https://developers.line.biz/en/docs/line-things/overview/): Connect IoT devices and experiences to the LINE platform.
- [LINE Social API](https://developers.line.biz/en/docs/social-api/overview/): Access profile and social graph features where supported.

## Support and Policies
- [LINE Help Center](https://help.line.me/): Support portal for account, app, payments, and service troubleshooting.
- [LINE Safety Center](https://line.me/safety/en/): Safety information, policies, and user protection resources.
- [LINE Privacy Policy](https://terms.line.me/line_rules/): Terms, rules, and policy entry point for LINE services.
- [LINE Terms and Policies](https://terms.line.me/): Central repository for legal terms and service policies.
- [LINE Developers Terms](https://developers.line.biz/en/terms-and-policies/): Terms, policies, and compliance information for developers using LINE APIs.
